caption: A pilot is a timeboxed plan with explicit gates: foundations first, a working version by mid-point, a go/continue/stop gate, then measurement and a sponsor decision.
alt: Week 0 kickoff confirms scope and criteria. Week 1 secures access, a baseline and tests risky assumptions. Weeks 2 to 3 deliver a first working version with real data and build the evaluation set. A gate at the end of week 3 decides to adjust, continue or stop. Weeks 4 to 5 put users on it daily and pass security review. Week 6 measures against the baseline and the sponsor decides go or no-go.
